package.name: livox_mid70_bridge
package.description: Minimal ROS2 bridge for Livox Mid-70 based on first-generation Livox-SDK. Mid-70 speaks the gen-1 protocol (broadcast on UDP 55000) and is NOT supported by livox_ros_driver2 / SDK2, so this bridge links the local gen-1 static SDK and republishes points as sensor_msgs/PointCloud2.
